description: This source file implements a socket server in C, supporting TCP and UDP protocols over IPv4 and IPv6. It includes functions for socket creation, binding, listening, accepting connections, and data transmission, along with a main menu for user interaction.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Displays the main menu options for TCP/UDP communication and exit.

methods.name: printIpv6orIpv4
methods.description: Prompts user to select IPv4 or IPv6 socket creation.

methods.name: createSocketCommunication
methods.description: Creates, binds, and manages socket communication based on protocol and IP type, handling data reception and echoing.
